title: Credits
notices: Most of his AI credits went on rewrites.

recorded.text: You've used most of your AI credits on rewrites.
Write the first draft yourself, and save the rest for the test.

new.text: Most of your credits went on rewrites.
If AI writes the thinking, whose thinking is Jay grading?

lines.text: Because credits run out before the scenario does.
Your own first draft costs nothing,
and Jay grades your thinking, not the rewrite.

then: Got it. He goes. A first draft in your own words costs nothing.
